name: CineStream
description: One stop solution for Movies, Series, Anime, AsianDrama and Torrents (includes CineAnime: AniList + TMDB + AnimePahe). v526: Fixed invisible WebView toggle - now truly hides ALL UI when ON. Uses a headless WebView (no bottom sheet, no dialog) that solves Cloudflare cookies silently in the background. Fixed cookie freshness check - cookies saved by older versions without a timestamp are treated as fresh. All v525 features retained: cookie age check (~30 min) on app open, probe throttle once per minute, skip probe when cookie fresh, stream-link cache ~20 min, one canonical AnimePahe domain (.pw).
